steps.heading: Getting Started with *Sem*
steps.say: Welcome! In this quick tutorial, you'll learn how to start talking with Sem, the AI companion by Sem dock.

steps.label: Open Sem
steps.caption: Go to *live.semdok.com* in your browser.
steps.say: Step one. Open your browser and go to live dot sem dock dot com. Sem runs right in the web page, so there is nothing to install.

steps.label: Meet Sem
steps.caption: Sem answers out loud, with *subtitles* on screen.
steps.say: Step two. Meet Sem. Sem is an animated companion who answers you out loud, and shows the reply as subtitles so you can read along.

steps.label: Type a question
steps.caption: Click *Ask Sem or request showcase…*, type, then press *send*.
steps.say: Step three. To type a question, click the box that says, Ask Sem or request showcase. Write your message, then press the send arrow.

steps.label: Talk with your voice
steps.caption: Prefer talking? Use the round *microphone* button.
steps.say: Step four. Prefer to talk? Use the round microphone button below the box. If your browser asks, allow microphone access, then simply speak.

steps.label: Sem replies
steps.caption: Here's Sem answering a real voice check.
steps.say: Here's Sem answering a real voice check. Listen.

steps.label: Sem replies
steps.caption: While Sem talks, the button shows a *speaker* icon.
steps.say: While Sem is talking, the round button shows a speaker icon, and the reply appears as subtitles above the message box.

steps.label: Explore the toolbar
steps.caption: More tools and *settings* live in the top-right toolbar.
steps.say: Step five. The toolbar in the top right corner holds more of Sem's tools, including settings. Explore it whenever you're ready.

steps.heading: Start talking with *Sem*
steps.say: That's it! Open live dot sem dock dot com and start your first conversation with Sem.
